summary: Tested View Mode toggle feature (desktop/mobile) across landing page and 5 roles (customer, provider, landlord, facilities, insurance). Toggle works, localStorage persistence works across refresh, MobileBottomNav renders correct role-specific tabs, More sheet opens, mobile menu drawer opens Sidebar and closes on navigation, TopBar contains ViewModeToggle in desktop, mobile pages render without horizontal scroll. One issue: ServicePicker dialog in mobile mode does not constrain to the 430px phone frame (renders 896px wide).

ui_bugs.component: ServicePicker Dialog on /post-job in mobile view
ui_bugs.issue: Dialog opens at 896px width, extending beyond the 430px phone frame (bounding box x=512, width=896). Requirement states 'ServicePicker dialog fills the phone width'. Currently the dialog uses default DialogContent max-w (sm:max-w-lg or similar) which is not clamped inside mobile-viewport-inner. On a real 430px viewport this would also overflow the screen.

issues: Only 3 tabs + More in grid-cols-6 leaves large empty gap on right side. Consider grid-cols-4 or centering the tabs for the insurance role.

action_items: Constrain ServicePicker Dialog width when in mobile view mode (e.g., max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] or scope to a mobile-friendly sm class) so it fits inside 430px phone frame and true mobile viewports.
(Optional) Improve MobileBottomNav layout for insurance role which has only 3 tabs — currently produces empty grid cells in grid-cols-6.
critical_code_review_comments: MobileBottomNav.jsx hard-codes grid-cols-6 which does not adapt to roles with fewer tabs (insurance has 3 tabs + More = 4 cells used, 2 empty).

ViewModeContext lazy init uses window.innerWidth < 768 default, which means users landing on mobile devices with no stored preference get mobile automatically — good. However this means E2E desktop-mode assumptions need explicit localStorage set (tests handled this).
MobileTopBar re-implements a scaled-down TopBar; some code duplication (cart badge, notifications, initials) could be extracted into a small shared component.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (11/12 verified flows; ServicePicker mobile width is the outlier)

test_credentials: Registered on-the-fly: qa-{role}-{ts}@dispatchr.demo / testpass123 across customer, provider, landlord, facilities, insurance roles.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ViewMode toggle, MobileBottomNav role tabs, More sheet, Sidebar mobile drawer, localStorage persistence, and desktop regression all pass. Only failing check is ServicePicker dialog width on /post-job in mobile view mode — it renders full 896px, breaking outside the 430px phone frame. Property role was not explicitly tested but shares customer-like tabs so likely fine. All routes tested (/client-home, /post-job, /marketplace, /messages, /more, /community-forum, /provider/dashboard, /provider/job-board, /provider/trade-store, /landlord/dashboard, /facilities/dashboard, /insurance/dashboard, /my-job-posts) show no horizontal scrollbar on the outer window.
rca of the issue: ServicePicker uses shadcn Dialog whose default DialogContent has max-w-lg (32rem = 512px) with responsive breakpoints; when rendered inside .mobile-viewport-inner (max-w 430px), the Dialog portal mounts to document.body (not inside the mobile viewport wrapper) so it is not clamped by parent CSS. Fix: add a mobile-view-aware max-width override (e.g., data-view-mode=mobile [role=dialog] { max-width: 430px !important }) in index.css targeting the html attribute, since Radix portals to body but the html has data-view-mode='mobile'.
